newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh tea prices fall slightly at auction.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh tea prices fall slightly at auction.

text.p: Bangladeshi tea prices fell slightly at the weekly auction on Tuesday, brokers said.
They said a few grades like large and bold brokens attracted overseas buyers such as Pakistan, Poland, Russia, Afghanistan, Sudan and Jordan. Local blenders also actively participated in the bidding.

Some 913,693 kgs of teas were sold at the auction. The average price was 45.83 taka per kg, 0.32 taka down from previous sale. The next auction will be held on December 10 with an expected offer of 1.18 million kg.
